run_perf_hook_before_job: run the Perf hook before_job method to initialize and start all available performance monitors for a benchmark job
run_perf_hook_after_job: run the Perf hook after_job method to terminate all monitors and write collected metrics to CSV files
configure_perf_monitors: configure performance monitor options like mpstat interval, perfstat additional events, or power sampling interval via the opts dictionary
review_perf_class: review the Perf class that extends Hook to manage lifecycle of mpstat, cpufreq, perfstat, netstat, memstat, topdown, and power monitors
summarize_avail_monitors: summarize the AVAIL_MONITORS mapping that links monitor names to their respective monitor classes from the perf_monitors submodule
